side.transfer_body: Scan items that arrived from another branch. Items for holds go to the hold shelf.

ov.audited: Overrides are recorded in the audit log with your name and reason.

receipt.no_patron: Receipts list one patron's visit. Load the patron first.
receipt.empty_title: Nothing to put on a receipt
receipt.empty: Check out or renew something for this patron first.

undo.checkout_done: Checkout undone. The item is back as it was.
undo.checkin_done: Check-in undone. The item is on loan again.
undo.notice_sent: The patron was already told the hold is ready

holds.title: Holds
holds.subtitle: Work the reservation queue, pull copies from the shelves, and look after the hold shelf and transfers.

intro.queue: Every active hold, oldest first. Select several to suspend, resume or cancel them together.
intro.pull: Copies that can fill a hold right now. Pull them shelf by shelf, then check them in at the desk to route them.
intro.ready: Items waiting for patrons to collect. Expired pickups go back into circulation when you clear them.
intro.transit: Copies on their way to the patron's pickup branch. Receive them at the desk when they arrive.

holds.branch_pull_hint: On the pull list this is the branch where the copy is shelved

empty.queue_body: Nothing matches these filters. Clear them, or place a hold for a patron.
empty.pull_body: No waiting hold can be filled from a copy on the shelves. New holds will appear here.
empty.ready_body: No items are waiting for pickup with these filters.
empty.transit_body: No copies are on their way to a pickup branch.

holds.pull_how: Tick items as you pull them (kept on this computer for today). Checking them in routes each one to the hold shelf or into transit.
holds.suspend_body: A suspended hold keeps its place in the queue but is skipped when copies come back.
holds.suspend_hint: Leave empty to suspend until someone resumes it.
holds.none_to_suspend: None of the selected holds can be suspended (they are already suspended or have a copy assigned).
holds.none_to_resume: None of the selected holds are suspended.

cancel_body.one: The patron loses their place in the queue. This can't be undone.
cancel_body.other: {count} patrons lose their place in the queue. This can't be undone.

clear_title.one: Clear this item from the hold shelf?
clear_title.other: Clear {count} items from the hold shelf?

clear_body.one: The hold is cancelled and the copy is offered to the next patron in the queue, or becomes available.
clear_body.other: The holds are cancelled and each copy is offered to the next patron in the queue, or becomes available.

holds.ph_find_hint: Pick a result to fill in the record number, or type the number yourself.
holds.ph_override: Override borrowing blocks and hold limits
holds.placed_pos: Hold placed for {name} on “{title}”: number {n} in the queue

task_hint.holds_to_pull: Copies on the shelves that can fill a hold
task_hint.holds_expiring: On the hold shelf, last pickup day within 2 days
task_hint.in_transit: On their way to a pickup branch
task_hint.overdue: Past their due date — see the overdue report
task_hint.notices_failed: Emails or texts that bounced in the last 7 days

kiosk.session_sub: You have {count} of {max} items on loan.
kiosk.blocked_help: You can still renew where allowed. Please ask at the desk to borrow.

receipt_lead.one: You borrowed or renewed {count} item this visit.
receipt_lead.other: You borrowed or renewed {count} items this visit.

kiosk.printing: Your receipt is printing. Please take it from the printer.
kiosk.email_failed: We couldn't email a receipt. Please ask at the desk if you need one.
kiosk.goodbye: Remember to check your due dates. See you soon!

kiosks.title: Kiosks
kiosks.subtitle: Self-checkout stations where patrons borrow and renew on their own. Each kiosk has its own secret token and works for one branch.
kiosks.how_1: Create a kiosk for the branch where the station stands. Copy its token: it is shown only once.
kiosks.how_2: On the station, open the kiosk screen and paste the token, or use “Set up this device” when you are working on the station itself. Your staff session is signed out automatically.
kiosks.how_3: Patrons sign in with their card number and password. Normal loan rules apply with no overrides, and items reserved for other readers can't be borrowed.
kiosks.how_4: Sessions end after a short time without activity, with a countdown. Station lost or stolen? Deactivate it or rotate its token.
kiosks.empty_body: Create one to let patrons borrow and renew on their own.
kiosks.token_once: Copy this token now. For security it is shown only once, and anyone who has it can run a kiosk for {branch}.
kiosks.here_title: Working on the kiosk station right now?
kiosks.here_body: Store the token in this browser, sign out of your staff account and open the kiosk screen.
kiosks.storage_blocked: This browser blocks local storage. Paste the token on the kiosk screen instead.
kiosks.name: Name
kiosks.name_placeholder: For example: Ground floor, by the entrance
kiosks.branch_hint: Loans made at this kiosk are recorded for this branch and use its loan rules.
kiosks.rotate_body: {name} stops working until you enter the new token on it. Anyone signed in there is signed out.
kiosks.delete_body: The device is removed and its token stops working straight away. Loans made there are kept.

cal.title: Calendar
cal.subtitle: When each branch is open. Due dates skip closed days, fines count only open days, and hold pickup windows are counted in open days.
cal.week_caption: Opening days of every branch this week
cal.hint: Choose a day to close it, open it specially, or remove a closure. Arrow keys move between days; Page Up and Page Down change the month.
cal.hint_readonly: Arrow keys move between days; Page Up and Page Down change the month.
cal.weekly_body: Days this branch is closed every week.
cal.none_body: Holidays and special openings you add appear here.
cal.remove_body: “{name}” will be removed from the calendar. Due dates already given don't change.
cal.closed_through_hint: For closures longer than a day, such as renovations.
cal.description_placeholder: For example: Diwali, staff training day
cal.repeats: Repeats every year on this date
cal.special_body: {branch} is normally closed on {weekday}s. Open it on {date}?
cal.no_branches: No branches are set up yet.
